technical_facts: Implemented dual processor acceleration (SMP) providing an initial 20%+ speedup in worst-case scenarios.
Expected average speedup from SMP to be 40% to 80% depending on video configuration and scene complexity.
SMP speedups are most significant in scenes with heavy dynamic lighting, sounds, and client processing.
Development is performed on Intergraph and SGI-NT hardware.
SMP implementation is being tested first on Windows (NT) and planned for the Linux port.
BeOS and SGI-irix ports are maintained by volunteers and are not officially supported.
BeOS has the code for Q3 and Q2.
SMP usage is viewed as an important technology to nurture for the future.
